# @thednp/rpc

Vite plugin for automatic RPC generation from server functions.

## Core API
- `createServerFunction(name, handler, options?)` — define a server function
- `import { fn } from "./api"` — call it from the client (auto-transformed to fetch) or server (the actual function)
- Returns `{ data: Promise<T>, cancel: (reason) => void }`

## Config
- `rpc.config.ts` with `defineConfig({ adapter, rpcPrefix })`
- Adapters: "express" | "fastify" | "hono" | "koa"

## Rules
- Server functions live in `src/api/server.ts`
- Re-export from `src/api/index.ts`
- First argument of server functions is always `AbortSignal`
- Arguments must be JSON-serializable
- Do NOT pass DOM nodes, functions, or class instances as arguments
